question: Does the account verification that an Elastic Email Free account needs before it can send ask for a phone number, and which fields does the profile survey show?
why: No first-party page names a phone number among the steps before the first send (a profile survey, a verified default domain, verify your account), and the API reference lists the phone number as an optional profile field. Third-party setup guides disagree: one reports a phone verification step on the onboarding page and also says no phone verification screen exists; another lists three survey screens (industry and employees; how the user heard of the service and why they chose it; goals, experience and earlier provider). The step is behind a sign-up, so identity_cost.kind stays email with the phone unverified. Needs an account: an operator step.
